newsitem.title: FRANCE: Deutsche's Walter-Buba Feb6 repo cut not ruled out.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche's Walter-Buba Feb6 repo cut not ruled out.

text.p: Deutsche Bank chief economist Norbert Walter said on Wednesday that he was not counting on a cut in the key repo interest rate when the Bundesbank meets on February 6, but such a move should not be ruled out.
Asked about Bundesbank policy at a conference of corporate treasurers, Walter said there was no reason in principle to believe the central bank was planning to cut its repo rate.
But he added: "We'll have to watch closely on February 6".
If the unemployment figures got seriously worse and if M3 money supply movement was in line with goals fixed at the end of 1996, there was a possibility of a move by the central bank.
Walter also said he could see the dollar reaching 120 Yen.
